subject: Workplace Skills
title: Trust Is Built in Small Moments
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Trust Is Built in Small Moments.

hook.text: Gottman's research on relationships applies at work too. Trust builds through hundreds of small moments.

buildup.text: Following through on a small promise matters more than a grand gesture. Reliability compounds over time.

discovery.text: Brene Brown calls these 'marble jar' moments. Each kept promise adds a marble. Each broken one empties several.

twist.text: Trust breaks asymmetrically. It takes dozens of deposits to build and one withdrawal to nearly empty the jar.

climax.text: Make small promises and keep every one. Reply when you said you would. Show up on time. Consistency builds trust.

punchline.text: Trust is built in inches. Broken in miles.

quiz.question: What does Brene Brown's 'marble jar' metaphor illustrate?
options: Trust requires one large act of vulnerability
Trust builds through many small kept promises and breaks easily
Trust is only relevant in personal relationships
